patthana15.69:1.1: Sauttaraṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naanuttaro nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Anuttaraṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naanuttaro nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā dve.
patthana15.69:2.1: Sauttaraṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naanuttaro naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ. (Abyākatamūle dve.)
